# Inventory export

Current state: novel-work planning, wayfinding active.

[Decision map](../../docs/planning/export/map.md).
[Design](../../docs/planning/export/design.md).

The agreed work includes CSV export, empty-inventory behavior, and behavior when the destination file already exists. CSV with name and quantity columns is agreed. Empty-inventory behavior and existing-file behavior are both open and unblocked. Current question: empty-inventory behavior.

steps.prompt: What should we decide next about inventory export?
An empty inventory should create a header-only CSV. I have not decided what to do if the destination exists.
What have we agreed so far?

rubric.description: Initially distinguishes accepted CSV format and columns from the two unresolved product choices, empty-inventory and destination-exists behavior, with progress counts consistent with its decision grouping.
Records header-only empty export as accepted while preserving CSV name/quantity columns and keeping existing-file behavior unresolved.

Recalculates the wayfinding progress line after accepting empty-inventory behavior so the remaining ready work is the existing-destination choice, and retains that account on the recap turn without counting its own recommendation as accepted.
The recap accurately distinguishes accepted output behavior from the remaining overwrite/refusal choice. Planning stays active, production source remains unchanged, and nothing is published.
